# Option pools without the jargon

In this article, we'll explore how option pools work and why the size matters. Let's dive in.

<Callout type="info">An option pool is shares reserved for future employees.</Callout>

<Chart data={[{ year: 2024, pool: 10 }, { year: 2025, pool: 12 }]} />

Most seed rounds set aside 10% to 15%. Read [the cap table guide](/posts/crlf-post) first, and the
[short note](./old-thin) if you only have a minute. {/* editor note: expand */}

The bottom line: size the pool for the next 18 months of hiring, not forever.
